metadata.name: Monster Hunt Brawler
metadata.description: v2: 2.5D monster-hunting brawler. Plunge rework (hang, slam, stuck recovery), half-HP large monsters, 3 lives per quest, Free Roam, new Bow / Mega Spear / Double Glaive, 3 Elites (Rexclaw, Ironhorn, Venomwing) with Elite quests, 9 armor sets and 36 craftable weapons. QWERT + arrows. Saves automatically (v1 saves migrate).
